releaseNotes: Closed three code-review P0s on the autonomy trust boundary: the budget evaluator now reads a live ledger accessor, tamper preflight plus audit-chain verify run at every dispatch batch boundary, and control/grants/waivers patches require an explicit founder-authority flag the autonomous session never passes.

Hardened fail-closed paths: NaN/non-finite budget and waiver amounts now reject, verification acceptance rejects empty-string evidence, and the migrator warns on dropped source_truth, autonomy.mode, and case-variant active gates instead of silently discarding them.

Removed the dead control.json stateHash field, aligned the reducer lock-ttl flag, made macOS wall-clock enforcement resolve gtimeout with an honest gap, and stopped the Doppler probe from ever surfacing a secret value.
